power.jaymospowers.xenoform.desc: A band of alien metal from a fallen star. Turn its dial and slam it: you become one of the aliens it holds, for a while, with its body and its moves. Scan creatures to teach it new ones.
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.starter: The band: hold %5$s and scroll to turn the dial, let go of %5$s to slam it and become the dialled alien (as an alien, hold it to turn back). A form lasts 1-5 minutes (always 5 once mastered); when its health is gone you're knocked back into your own body. Fists only while changed. A corrupted band glitches: slams can give the wrong alien, and it may change you on its own
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.ability_: The dialled alien's first move (slam the band with %5$s to change first)
Fist Combo: three quick blows on whatever is in reach; the last sends it flying
Ground Clap: a shockwave through everything within 5 blocks
Grab: lift the creature you look at overhead; again to hurl it. Looking at the ground instead rips a chunk out and throws it
Leap Slam: a great leap; the landing hits everything within 4 blocks
Fire Bolt: a small fireball where you look
Flame Jet: G to take off and hover (WASD, Jump rises, Sneak sinks), Sprint to streak along your look as a comet of flame; G again, or Sneak on the ground, to come down. Free
Fire Nova: everything within 5 blocks is burnt and set alight
Magma Trail: for 6 seconds the ground burns where you step
Velocity (toggle): run far faster, up walls, over blocks and across water in a light blue streak; Shift walks, R again stops
Rapid Punches: six quick blows on the creature you aim at
Cyclone: sweeps everything within 6 blocks round you in a tight circle and lifts it
Chain Strike: flicker between up to 5 foes within 8 blocks, striking each
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.mode: Hold and scroll: turn the dial. Let go: slam the band and become the dialled alien. As an alien, hold to turn back
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.mode.bul: Hold and let go: turn back into yourself (the charge left stays in the band). Hold and scroll, then let go: quick change, a quarter of the charge
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.mode.pyr: Hold and let go: turn back into yourself (the charge left stays in the band). Hold and scroll, then let go: quick change, a quarter of the charge
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.mode.blu: Hold and let go: turn back into yourself (the charge left stays in the band). Hold and scroll, then let go: quick change, a quarter of the charge
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.special: Scan (hold, as yourself): point at a creature for 3 seconds; if it carries an alien's DNA, the band learns that alien. Iron golem, blaze, horse, shulker, phantom, silverfish, the Warden and the Ender Dragon
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.ultimate: Ultimate (once the band is complete and the power mastered, the power ascends): as an alien, %6$s turns you into its Ultimate form, a bigger armoured body with spikes and glowing seams, half again the health on top, harder fists and every move back twice as fast, until the charge runs out. Its own move, where it has one, is on %4$s. %6$s again drops you back to the base alien. As yourself, nothing: slam first
Ultimate
item.jaymospowers.xeno_band.lore: A band of alien metal, warm to the touch. It wants a wrist.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.band_close: The band closes round your wrist. It won't come off.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.band_refus: The band won't close: something in you already answers to another power.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.only_one: The band only knows %s. Scan creatures to teach it more.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.hold_z: Hold the Power Mode key, scroll to pick an alien, and let go to slam the band.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.scan_human: The band can't scan while you're changed.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.unlocked: The band takes in new DNA: %s.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.star_band: Something glints in the broken star: a band of alien metal.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.star_symbi: Black goo oozes out of the broken star and gathers itself on the rock, watching you.
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.ability_: Crystal Shards: three shards fan out where you look, each cutting the first thing in its way
Crystal Wall: a wall of amethyst rises 3 blocks ahead of you for 10 seconds
Reflect (hold): root yourself in crystal; arrows that hit you fly back at the shooter, other projectiles shatter
Spike Field: crystal bursts from the ground, cutting and slowing everything within 4 blocks
Phase: slip through a wall up to 2 blocks thick
Shroud: fade from sight until you strike something (again to show yourself)
Dread Wail: every creature within 10 blocks turns and flees; players are plunged into darkness
Glide (hold): fall slowly and drift forward. A ghost is never hurt by a fall
Spring: a huge jump, landing softly
Sabotage: from up to 16 blocks, flip a lever or button, throw a door, trapdoor or gate, or pop a piece of redstone off its block
Bite: a nip that steals hunger from the bitten and feeds you
Climb (hold): scuttle straight up any wall. You fit through one-block gaps
Sonic Boom: a ringing blast straight ahead that goes through walls
Tremor Sense (hold): everything that lives within 24 blocks glows for you
Shriek: everything within 12 blocks is hurt, plunged into darkness and slowed
Burrow: sink into the ground and come up where you look, up to 16 blocks away
Dragon's Breath: a cloud of purple fire ahead of you
Wings (hold): fly where you look, for free; let go and you drift down
Wing Gust: one great beat throws everything within 6 blocks away from you
Rift: step through the void to where you look, up to 12 blocks. Water and rain burn you
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.glitch_wro: The band glitches: that's not the alien you dialled.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.glitch_sel: The band glitches and changes you on its own!
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.mode.pri: Hold and let go: turn back into yourself (the charge left stays in the band). Hold and scroll, then let go: quick change, a quarter of the charge
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.mode.wis: Hold and let go: turn back into yourself (the charge left stays in the band). Hold and scroll, then let go: quick change, a quarter of the charge
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.mode.gre: Hold and let go: turn back into yourself (the charge left stays in the band). Hold and scroll, then let go: quick change, a quarter of the charge
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.mode.kne: Hold and let go: turn back into yourself (the charge left stays in the band). Hold and scroll, then let go: quick change, a quarter of the charge
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.mode.wyr: Hold and let go: turn back into yourself (the charge left stays in the band). Hold and scroll, then let go: quick change, a quarter of the charge
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.ultimate: Titan: twice your size with a hide of stone (+12 armour, +20 health); the Ground Clap smashes walls up to 3 blocks thick ahead of you
Titan
Sunheart: the Flame Jet streaks faster with a longer comet, and R is a held beam of fire 12 blocks long
Sunheart
Standstill: for 6 s everything within 24 blocks crawls and every projectile hangs in the air, and you are fast; %4$s every 30 s
Standstill
Geode: everything within 6 blocks is cased in crystal for 4 s (held fast, no striking), projectiles shatter, and you're hard as the crystal; %4$s again every 20 s
Geode
Revenant: slip into the creature you look at (8 blocks) and wear it for 10 s: it goes where you look and nothing hunts you; %4$s lets go
Revenant
Swarm: you split into 4 glowing gremlins that bite what you bite; %4$s swaps you with the farthest one (nearest while sneaking)
Swarm
The Tolling: plant yourself and toll 5 times, every 2 s a ring of sonic force (6 damage, a shove, darkness) through everything within 8 blocks; %4$s again after 30 s
The Tolling
Elder Wyrm: twice your size with +8 armour, a breath every 2 s and a gust that reaches 50% farther
Elder Wyrm
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.ultimate_h: Slam the band first: the Ultimate is the alien's.
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.ability_: Split: a double of you steps out (up to 3), and your name grows: Triplex, Quadruplex... Each has 6 health; together they surround what you fight and strike in turn, harder the more of them there are; if one dies, you take 2

Rally: your doubles swarm the creature you aim at (16 blocks); aimed at nothing, they come back. Sneak: Fetch, a double picks up the solid block you aim at and carries it; sneak again to have it set it down where you aim
Switch: trade places with the double you aim at, or the farthest one
Merge: every double within 24 blocks runs back into you, each healing you 3
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.mode.dup: Hold and let go: turn back into yourself (the charge left stays in the band). Hold and scroll, then let go: quick change, a quarter of the charge
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.ultimate: Copper Storm: a full set of doubles, then lightning on each: 6 damage to everything within 3 of them, and they're charged (fast, strong, glowing) for 20 s; up to 6 doubles meanwhile. %4$s strikes again, every 20 s
Copper Storm
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.ability_: Beacon: tap to pick a player anywhere in the world (tap again for the next; they show through everything for a moment); hold to phase to them, whatever world they're in

Rift: tap at a creature for Recursive Drop (a maw under it and one in the sky: it falls through, over and over, 7 times); tap at nothing to blink where you look (16 blocks); hold to Surface, straight up to the highest safe ground; sneak + G opens the Void Pocket (27 slots, kept for the next Nadir)

Graviton: at a creature, Heavy Hand (tap: yank it to you; hold: slam and pin it; sneak + tap: shove it away; sneak + hold: throw it high). At nothing, tap: a Weightless zone where you look (what enters floats up helpless, then drops hard). At nothing, hold: an Event Horizon, a black hole that drags everything in, erases small things at its core, then collapses (once every 45 s)
Command: open the Rules screen and write up to three rules (WHO + WHAT + WHEN, such as "what I hit / burns / while sprinting"); two can hold at once, while Nadir is out
power.jaymospowers.xenoform.key.ultimate: Three Worlds Film: a short film (any key skips your camera) of the Overworld, the Nether and the Aether flashing up behind what you look at, then a heavy blow that hurts what stands close too (once every 75 s). Only a picture: no portal, no new world
Three Worlds Film
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.beacon_alo: There is no one else to go to.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.beacon_arr: %s steps out of the void behind you.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.nadir.rift: No room between ground and sky for the maws.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.nadir.surf: There is no safe ground above.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.nadir.hori: A black hole is already open.
The void is still gathering: %s s.
screen.jaymospowers.nadir_rules.sub: Write what the world must do. %s rules hold at once.
screen.jaymospowers.nadir_rules.help: Click a word to change it (sneak-click goes back), and the switch to make a rule hold. Rules hold only while Nadir is out, and wait here for the next time.
screen.jaymospowers.nadir_rules.what.dar: Night vision, for as long as the rule holds.
screen.jaymospowers.nadir_rules.what.bur: Set alight for 4 s (no more than every 2 s, or once a second for each creature struck).
screen.jaymospowers.nadir_rules.what.wea: Weakness II and Mining Fatigue: it hits softly and works slowly.
screen.jaymospowers.nadir_rules.what.pus: Thrown away from you. Does nothing to you.
screen.jaymospowers.nadir_rules.what.pul: Dragged toward you. Does nothing to you.
screen.jaymospowers.nadir_rules.what.bur: A burst of the void round it: 2.5 hearts and a throw to everything within 3 blocks but you and yours.
screen.jaymospowers.nadir_rules.what.pai: Takes 2 hearts. Does nothing to you.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.name: Hush
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.name: Clamour
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.wake: ...you've gone far enough into the band to hear us. I am the still one. We will ask, and ask again, for as long as you wear it.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.wake: AND I AM THE LOUD ONE. You've broken the band and climbed it both. Good. Now ANSWER, and keep answering.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.given: Then we agree, for once. Take what we keep: the void given shape. Once. Then you will answer us again.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.give: NADIR IS YOURS. ONCE. Don't make us sorry.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.already: You have answered me. I am still thinking on it.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.alre: YOU SAID YOUR PIECE. Now DO something.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.nadir_refu: The band will not turn: the voices are not content.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.q0: When you could strike, will you stay your hand?
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.q0: When you could stay your hand, WILL YOU STRIKE?
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.yes0: Then there is hope for you yet.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.no0: No. That is not what you are. I will ask again.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.no0: LIAR. Nobody holds back who's held THIS. Again, later.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.q1: Is the band a gift, to be kept whole?
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.q1: Is the band a WEAPON, to be spent?
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.yes1: SPEND IT, THEN. Spend it all.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.no1: A thing this old is not spent. I will ask again.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.no1: A GIFT? It eats you alive and you call it a GIFT? Again, later.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.q2: Would you give the band up, if the world asked it?
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.q2: Would you BURN the world before you gave it up?
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.yes2: Then you may be trusted with it.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.yes2: GOOD. Mine, and yours. Nobody else's.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.no2: You would not. I heard it in you. Again, later.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.no2: COWARD. You'd hand us over? Think again.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.q3: Are the creatures you wear still themselves, somewhere in you?
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.q3: Are they only SHAPES, worn and thrown away?
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.no3: They are. You've only not listened. Again, later.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.no3: SENTIMENT. They're meat you learned. Again.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.q4: Would you walk away from a fight you could win?
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.q4: Would you finish a fight you could WALK FROM?
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.no4: You would not walk. Not yet. Again, later.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.no4: WALK? From a WIN? Again, and mean it.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.q5: If I asked you to put the band down for a day, would you?
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.q5: If I asked you to wear it a DAY WITHOUT TURNING BACK, would you?
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.yes5: Then it does not own you.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.yes5: THAT'S the spirit. Never come down.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.no5: It owns you more than you know. Again, later.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.no5: You'd take it OFF? Again, later, when you've thought.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.contrad: (...you told the other what it wished to hear as well. So be it. Both of us are listening now.)
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.cont: (YOU TOLD THE OTHER THE OPPOSITE. Hah. Fine. We'll BOTH see what you do.)
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.deed.pe: Change, and let the change run its whole course without a blow struck. %s times. Then I am content.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.deed.re: Change, and turn back by your own hand before the band makes you. %s times. Then I am content.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.deed: CHANGE, AND END %s LIVES AS ONE OF US. Then I'm content. Not before.
CHANGE, AND BE BEATEN OUT OF THE SHAPE %s TIMES. Bleed for it. Then I'm content.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.count.p: %s of %s changes have passed in peace.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.count.r: %s of %s changes ended by your own hand.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.done.re: %s times you let go. I am content.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.done: %s BEATINGS TAKEN. I'M CONTENT. For now.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.lent: We are content. Once more, the void is yours to wear.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.hush.spent: And it is gone from you again. We have new questions.
voice.jaymospowers.xenoform.clamour.spen: THAT'S YOUR TURN SPENT. Earn the next one.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.nadir.film: The film needs someone to show.
The reel is still rewinding: %s s.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.band_won: You tear the band off %s's wrist. It's yours now.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.band_lost: %s tore the band from your wrist.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.saved: The band slammed itself: %s took the blow.
message.jaymospowers.xenoform.wild_stuck: The wild dial won't let you go.
